CANONICAL_NAME.value: MiniSom -- a minimal Self-Organizing Map in Python (Giuseppe Vettigli)

VERSION.value: github.com/JustGlowing/minisom master as of 2026-09-12 (commit in hashes)

value.lineage: The Self-Organizing Map (Kohonen 1982): an unsupervised connectionist network whose neurons arrange on a grid and adapt so that nearby neurons respond to similar inputs -- competitive learning that forms a topology-preserving map of the data

value.built_to: learn, without labels, a low-dimensional (grid) representation of high-dimensional data where neighbouring grid cells respond to similar inputs -- competitive, neighbourhood-cooperative weight adaptation
value.pressure: unlabelled high-dimensional data with unknown structure; the map must discover clusters and topology by competition alone
value.success_means: a topology-preserving map: similar inputs excite nearby neurons, and quantization error falls as it self-organises

value.pressure: unlabelled, high-dimensional data; no supervisory signal
value.failure_condition: a bad learning rate/neighbourhood schedule leaves the map twisted or collapsed -- it fails to separate the clusters

ANCESTRY.value: The Self-Organizing Map (Kohonen 1982): an unsupervised connectionist network whose neurons arrange on a grid and adapt so that nearby neurons respond to similar inputs -- competitive learning that forms a topology-preserving map of the data
